settings.heading: Consign a piece with us
settings.body: An alternative to selling outright: we list and present the piece, and the terms are agreed with you in writing first.

settings.title: Enquire
settings.text: Tell us about the piece, its condition and your expectations.

settings.title: We discuss terms
settings.text: Pricing approach, duration and fees, confirmed in writing before anything proceeds.

settings.title: Hand over
settings.text: We agree how the piece reaches us and how it is handled while with us.

settings.title: Listing and sale
settings.text: The piece is presented and offered. You are kept informed.

settings.heading: How consignment works
settings.body: Every arrangement is set out in writing before anything is collected or listed. Fees, duration, pricing and what happens if a piece does not sell are agreed with you in advance — we do not publish standard rates, because they depend on the piece.

settings.heading: Consignment enquiry
settings.body: Tell us what you are considering consigning and we will explain the options.
settings.note: An enquiry is not an agreement. Nothing is listed and nothing is collected until terms are confirmed in writing.
settings.message_hint: Character, studio, scale, condition, packaging, and what you are hoping to achieve.
settings.success: Thank you — your consignment enquiry has been sent.
